name: Kaggle Prediction Benchmark
description: Benchmark an AI agent's ability to write predictive programs from Kaggle datasets. The agent receives training data, writes a Python program with a predict() function, and iteratively improves it across multiple steps.

binding_vow.description: Agent must write a Python program that defines predict(). The program reads train.csv and test.csv, learns patterns from train.csv, and predict() returns predictions for test.csv. Score = accuracy (classification) or R² clamped to [0,1] (regression).

observation_space.description: { "task": str, "data_dir": str, "work_dir": str, "train_file": str, "test_file": str, "target_column": str, "feature_columns": [str], "data_preview": [dict], "is_classification": bool, "step": int, "max_steps": int, "best_score": float }

action_space.description: Python program code as raw text. Must define predict() returning a list/array of predictions.

reward.description: Accuracy (classification) or R² clamped to [0,1] (regression) of predict() output vs test targets.
